dogecoin.text: @Rubbishmael The link to Elon is probably because they were hoping his high profile would widen the pool of people buying Dogecoin, but I can't say for certain.

@Rubbishmael I saw someone say the price drop was from those with large quantities of Dogecoin selling to depress the price and induce panic selling in others so when the price drops below what they sold it for they can buy it back and make a profit or buy more than they had at the start.
